---
title: "Profile, Freeze, and Execution Directory Fixture"
format: gfm
---

The document lives in `reports/` but reads a root-relative path, which only works because
`execute-dir: project` is set under `project:` in `_quarto.yml`.

```{r}
#| label: read-metrics
cat("cwd:", basename(getwd()), "\n")
read.csv("data/metrics.csv")$value
```
